occurrences.verification_scope: Blind visual comparison of one target glyph with two unlabeled source-book printed-form controls, shuffled in a crop. Ignore linguistic meaning, source text, prior verdicts and the proposed replacement; compare pixels only. Determine which control’s LOWER STROKE pattern matches the target: one has a lower component whose right edge closes across the internal horizontal strokes, the other has the lower horizontal strokes open on the right. Return the exact printed character only if the matching control can be identified from visible pixels; otherwise use unresolved_identity. The scan/crops are original source pixels; the comparison panel contains unlabelled shuffled controls.
